desc.zh_HK: 封咗口但冇貼郵票嘅信，字跡係女性嘅。
desc.zh_CN: 封了口却没有贴邮票的信，字迹出自女性之手。
desc.en: A sealed letter that never got a stamp; a woman's handwriting.

use_locked.en: The letter can't help right now.

text.zh_HK: 信封喺手度輕咗——1996年，樓上有燈。
text.zh_CN: 信封在手里变轻了——1996年，楼上有灯。
text.en: The envelope feels lighter in your hand. 1996 — a lamp burns upstairs.

_comment: The chapter-5 door: usable once ch04 is complete — the letter is finally carried by 阿雪 to the address her mother left.
